description: This file is a shell script for testing Git merge message generation, including various merge scenarios such as local branches, octopus merges, tags, ambiguous tags, and remote-tracking branches. It defines tests that perform Git operations and verify the resulting merge commit messages.

methods.name: check_oneline
methods.description: Checks if the latest git log message matches the expected message.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with a specified message.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expect and actual output for verification.
